info.title: Flame Connect — account and Wi-Fi control API
info.description: Unofficial contract recovered from Android app 2.24.2, supplemented by a real capture and user-reported validation. Other routes are static reconstructions; server acceptance is not guaranteed. Guest backend contracts are retained in x-client-variants. The local laboratory is not this specification's server. Wi-Fi targets use Celsius regardless of the device display scale.

post.description: Writes device TLV parameters through the cloud. Read state first, copy each packet, and edit only known bytes. The app reads state again afterwards. Power-on changes Mode and the available heating/flame parameters; changing Mode alone does not reproduce the app button.
